readings: Inner-join each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (transref = transreg) and that record's trader (trdref = tradereg). For each (transref, tradekind) pair, compute the average optvolrt. Take the overall average optvolrt to be the mean of optvolrt over all joined snapshot rows. Define each pair's deviation as the ABSOLUTE difference |pair average − overall average|. If the overall average is missing, return no rows. Within each tradekind, drop pairs with no tradekind, then keep only pairs whose absolute deviation is strictly greater than that tradekind's average absolute deviation. The excess is the pair's deviation minus that average. For each tradekind, return the average of the pair average optvolrt, the average deviation, and the average excess for the kept pairs. Ignore missing values and do not round.

Ignore missing values and do not round.

queries:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, s.optvolrt AS optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS ov FROM joined
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS pair_avg
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
dev AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, ABS(p.pair_avg - o.ov) AS dev
  FROM pairs p, overall o
  WHERE o.ov IS NOT NULL AND p.tradekind IS NOT NULL AND p.pair_avg IS NOT NULL
),
kavg AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(dev) AS avg_dev FROM dev GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT d.tradekind,
       AVG(d.pair_avg) AS avg_pair_avg,
       AVG(d.dev) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(d.dev - k.avg_dev) AS avg_excess
FROM dev d
JOIN kavg k ON d.tradekind = k.tradekind
WHERE d.dev > k.avg_dev
GROUP BY d.tradekind;
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, s.optvolrt AS optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS oa FROM joined
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT j.transref, j.tradekind, AVG(j.optvolrt) AS pair_avg, AVG(j.optvolrt) - o.oa AS dev
  FROM joined j, overall o
  WHERE o.oa IS NOT NULL AND j.tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY j.transref, j.tradekind
),
kavg AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(dev) AS avg_dev
  FROM pairs
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT p.tradekind,
       AVG(p.pair_avg) AS avg_pair_avg,
       AVG(p.dev) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(p.dev - k.avg_dev) AS avg_excess
FROM pairs p
JOIN kavg k ON p.tradekind = k.tradekind
WHERE p.dev > k.avg_dev
GROUP BY p.tradekind;
WITH pair AS (
  SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS pair_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_avg FROM pair
),
dev AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, ABS(p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg) AS deviation
  FROM pair p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND p.tradekind IS NOT NULL
),
kavg AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS avg_dev
  FROM dev
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT d.tradekind,
       AVG(d.pair_avg) AS avg_pair_avg,
       AVG(d.deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(d.deviation - k.avg_dev) AS avg_excess
FROM dev d
JOIN kavg k ON d.tradekind = k.tradekind
WHERE d.deviation > k.avg_dev
GROUP BY d.tradekind;
WITH pair AS (
  SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS pavg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(pavg) AS oavg FROM pair
),
dev AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pavg, p.pavg - o.oavg AS dev
  FROM pair p, overall o
  WHERE o.oavg IS NOT NULL AND p.tradekind IS NOT NULL AND p.pavg IS NOT NULL
),
kd AS (
  SELECT transref, tradekind, pavg, dev,
         AVG(dev) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS kavg
  FROM dev
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(pavg) AS avg_pair_optvolrt,
       AVG(dev) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(dev - kavg) AS avg_excess
FROM kd
WHERE dev > kavg
GROUP BY tradekind;
